scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'),path=require('path'); const target=path.resolve(__dirname,'../../aidlinkx-frontend/aidlinkx-app'); cp.execSync('npm run build',{cwd:target,stdio:'inherit'}); const src=path.join(target,'dist/aidlinkx-app/browser'); const dest1=path.resolve(__dirname,'dist/resqgrid-app'); const dest2=path.resolve(__dirname,'dist/aidlinkx-app/browser'); fs.mkdirSync(dest1,{recursive:true}); fs.cpSync(src,dest1,{recursive:true}); fs.mkdirSync(dest2,{recursive:true}); fs.cpSync(src,dest2,{recursive:true});"
